The '''Defenestrator''' was the nickname of a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was one of the winners of the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]], along with [[Bloodworthy]], [[Jewl'a Nightbringer]], and [[Hunter (individual)|Mandalore's Chosen]]. The Defenstrator, along with Nightbringer and Bloodworthy, was [[Grand Champions massacre|killed]] by a squad of [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Republic SIS]] agents and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] after they refused to disclose the whereabouts of their latest Champion, the bounty hunter whom [[Jun Seros (Jedi)|Jun Seros]] was determined to bring in. The Defenestrator's body soon activated a [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct]] sequence, causing a brief enough distraction that scattered the strike team before they could engage the Champion.
